common.unreachable: Could not reach the hub. Check your connection.
common.name: Name

signup.title: Create your account
signup.blurb: Somewhere for your versions to live, so the work you did tonight is still there tomorrow.

broken.title: This link doesn’t work
broken.unknown: That link does not name anything. Ask for a new one.
broken.footer: Ask whoever shared the score to send you a new one.

join.title: Join “{{score}}”
join.blurb: {{invitedBy}} invited you. You’ll be able to open the score, read every version of it and save your own.
join.failed: Could not join this score. Try again.

credentials.title: “{{name}}” is ready to sync.
credentials.instruction: Open the companion app, choose Set up sync, and paste these three values in.
credentials.detail: Its dialog has the same three fields, in the same order. After that you can forget all of this — every save you make is stored on its own.
credentials.shownOnceDetail: The token isn't stored anywhere we can read it back. Leave this screen and it's gone for good.

scores.title: Scores
scores.upstreamDown: Can't reach the sync server right now. Your scores and everything you've saved are safe — you just can't add a new score until it's back.
scores.unavailable: Unavailable while the server is down
scores.empty: A score is one song, versioned. Create one and every save in Guitar Pro lands here.
scores.importExisting: Import a file you already have
scores.caption: A square is a computer this score has reached. Token values are never shown again after a score is created — each machine gets its own.
scores.unfinishedExplanation: This score has storage but no sign-in details yet. Finish setup to get its URL, username and token — nothing you've saved is lost.

devices.noVersions: {{name}} — has the score, no versions saved from it yet

create.title: Create score
create.description: Give it the song's name. This takes a few seconds — we're setting up storage for it on the server.

import.title: Import a score
import.description: A Guitar Pro file — {{extensions}}. It becomes the score's first version, exactly as if you had saved it from the companion.
import.tooLarge: That file is over 32 MB, which is more than the hub takes.
import.stranded: “{{name}}” was created, but the file did not make it. The score and its sign-in details are real — only the music is missing, which is the same state a score is in before its first save. Send the file again, or push to it from the companion.

clone.title: Add “{{name}}” to this computer
clone.description: Gitarpro should be asking you where to save it. It gets its own sign-in details for this machine — nothing is shared with the computer you set the score up on.

invite.title: Invite someone to “{{name}}”
invite.description: Send them this link. Whoever opens it and signs in joins the score and can save versions to it — so send it to the band and not to a public channel.
invite.failed: Could not make a link. Try again.
invite.expires: It works once, and stops working {{when}}.

members.pending: Invited by {{invitedBy}} — nobody has opened the link yet. It stops working {{when}}.

score.selectedRange: {{count}} selected · click a row to reset
score.ahead_one: {{count}} version ahead of the main line.
score.ahead_other: {{count}} versions ahead of the main line.

empty.title: No versions yet.
empty.body: Open the score in Guitar Pro, press <kbd>⌥⌘G</kbd>, type what you changed and hit Enter. It shows up here straight away.

history.showing: Showing the {{loaded}} most recent versions of {{total}}.

player.unreadable: This version can't be shown here — the file is a Guitar Pro format the web player doesn't read. Open it in Gitarpro instead.
